tools.name: waitlyze_explain_capabilities
tools.description: Returns Waitlyze platform architecture, auth model, REST API v1 endpoints, MCP resources/prompts, scopes, and webhook events so agents can operate the entire platform without opening the dashboard.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists all accessible workspaces with role, plan tier, waitlist count, member count, and live total signups.

tools.name: waitlyze_get_workspace
tools.description: Returns full workspace details: plan entitlements, live usage counters, and connected email integrations.

tools.name: waitlyze_create_workspace
tools.description: Creates a new team workspace for the authenticated user (account-wide auth only).

tools.name: waitlyze_update_workspace
tools.description: Renames an accessible workspace.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_workspace_members
tools.description: Lists all workspace members, roles, and pending invitations.

tools.name: waitlyze_manage_workspace_member
tools.description: Invite a teammate, change a member's role (ADMIN/MEMBER), remove a member, or revoke an invitation.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_audit_events
tools.description: Lists security and operational audit events for a workspace.

tools.name: waitlyze_manage_suppressions
tools.description: List, add, or remove bounced/complained/unsubscribed emails in the workspace suppression list.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_api_keys
tools.description: Lists API keys accessible to the caller (redacted hashes; shows prefix, scopes, and target waitlist/workspace).

tools.name: waitlyze_create_api_key
tools.description: Creates a waitlist-scoped or workspace-scoped wl2_ API key with granular scopes (plaintext key returned once).

tools.name: waitlyze_revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revokes an API key immediately by key ID.

tools.name: waitlyze_manage_workspace_email_integration
tools.description: Inspect, connect, test, list Resend domains, or disconnect workspace-level Resend or Cloudflare Email sending.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_waitlists
tools.description: Lists all accessible waitlists with live totalSignups, publication status, publicUrl, and customDomain.

tools.name: waitlyze_get_waitlist
tools.description: Returns full details of a waitlist including live totalSignups, verifiedSignups, customDomain, publicUrl, and form/reward configuration.

tools.name: waitlyze_create_waitlist
tools.description: Creates a new draft waitlist inside an accessible workspace.

tools.name: waitlyze_update_waitlist
tools.description: Updates top-level settings of a waitlist (name, description, websiteUrl, publicSlug, showReferrals, sendEmailsToSubscribers, templateId).

tools.name: waitlyze_get_waitlist_page
tools.description: Returns the complete hosted page builder snapshot (sections, brand, statusPage, seo, form, rewards) and revision numbers.

tools.name: waitlyze_update_waitlist_page
tools.description: Saves full or partial page builder updates (sections, brand, statusPage, seo, theme, form, rewards) with optimistic revision locking.

tools.name: waitlyze_configure_form_rules
tools.description: Updates signup form rules: doubleOptIn, blockDisposable, collectPhone, requirePhone, customFields, marketingConsentCopy.

tools.name: waitlyze_configure_rewards
tools.description: Configures signup/referral/streak point rules, hideCounts, customEvents, and referral milestone reward tiers.

tools.name: waitlyze_run_launch_rehearsal
tools.description: Runs pre-flight checks (slug, email sender, domain, copy completeness, form rules, plan capacity) before publishing live.

tools.name: waitlyze_publish_waitlist
tools.description: Publishes the current draft snapshot so the hosted page and widgets go live.

tools.name: waitlyze_pause_waitlist
tools.description: Pauses a live waitlist (public page shows paused notice and blocks new signups).

tools.name: waitlyze_rollback_waitlist
tools.description: Rolls back the live waitlist page to the previous published snapshot revision.

tools.name: waitlyze_delete_waitlist
tools.description: Permanently deletes a waitlist and all associated subscribers, broadcasts, and webhooks.

tools.name: waitlyze_get_analytics
tools.description: Returns live 15-minute & daily traffic/signup funnel, conversion rate, referral K-factor, top UTMs, countries, cities, and devices.

tools.name: waitlyze_manage_custom_domain
tools.description: Inspect, connect, verify DNS, or remove a custom domain for a waitlist hosted page.

tools.name: waitlyze_manage_email_sender
tools.description: Inspect effective sender (waitlist vs workspace), configure waitlist-specific Resend key + From address, send test email, or remove override.

tools.name: waitlyze_manage_chat_notifications
tools.description: Get, configure, test, or disconnect Slack or Discord waitlist notifications.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_webhooks
tools.description: Lists configured webhook subscriptions for a waitlist (supported events & status).

tools.name: waitlyze_create_webhook
tools.description: Creates a new webhook subscription (returns signing secret once).

tools.name: waitlyze_update_webhook
tools.description: Updates name, url, events, enabled status, or includeSubscriberData on a webhook.

tools.name: waitlyze_test_webhook
tools.description: Dispatches a live test signup.created event to a webhook subscription.

tools.name: waitlyze_rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Rotates the HMAC signing secret of a webhook subscription and returns the new secret once.

tools.name: waitlyze_manage_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Lists recent webhook delivery attempts or replays a failed delivery.

tools.name: waitlyze_delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes a webhook subscription.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_subscribers
tools.description: Paginated list of subscribers with live queue positions, points, referral counts, verification, and UTM attribution.

tools.name: waitlyze_get_subscriber
tools.description: Looks up a subscriber by subscriberId or email, returning live queue position, totalSignups, referralUrl, rewardSummary, and recent point events.

tools.name: waitlyze_add_subscriber
tools.description: Adds a subscriber to a waitlist (idempotent on email), optionally auto-verifies & awards configured signup/referral points, and returns live position + totalSignups + referralUrl.

tools.name: waitlyze_import_subscribers
tools.description: Imports up to 500 JSON subscriber records into a waitlist in a single batch.

tools.name: waitlyze_update_subscriber
tools.description: Updates verified status, phone, customFields, or marketingConsent for a subscriber.

tools.name: waitlyze_remove_subscriber
tools.description: Deletes a subscriber from a waitlist and returns updated live totalSignups.

tools.name: waitlyze_bulk_audience_action
tools.description: Performs bulk audience operations (offboard, resubscribe, delete, or retry_verification) on up to 200 subscriber IDs.

tools.name: waitlyze_award_points
tools.description: Awards points to a verified subscriber for a custom event (with idempotency key).

tools.name: waitlyze_export_subscribers
tools.description: Exports up to 1000 subscribers per page as structured JSON with cursor pagination (`hasMore`, `nextOffset`).

tools.name: waitlyze_get_leaderboard
tools.description: Returns the top referrers, live queue positions, points, and live waitlist totals.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_referral_reviews
tools.description: Lists flagged or pending referral reviews for fraud moderation.

tools.name: waitlyze_resolve_referral_review
tools.description: Resolves a referral fraud alert by setting status to APPROVED or EXCLUDED.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_broadcasts
tools.description: Lists broadcasts on a waitlist with status, segment, scheduledAt, sentAt, and recipientCount.

tools.name: waitlyze_preview_broadcast_recipients
tools.description: Counts opted-in eligible recipients and shows masked sample emails for a segment.

tools.name: waitlyze_create_broadcast
tools.description: Creates (or updates if broadcastId is provided) a draft broadcast. Accepts markdown/text body or Tiptap editorDocument.

tools.name: waitlyze_delete_broadcast
tools.description: Deletes a draft or canceled broadcast.

tools.name: waitlyze_send_broadcast
tools.description: Queues and sends a draft broadcast to opted-in segment recipients via the configured sender (enforces plan & sender checks).

tools.name: waitlyze_schedule_broadcast
tools.description: Schedules a draft broadcast for a future ISO-8601 timestamp (up to 90 days ahead).

tools.name: waitlyze_cancel_broadcast
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled or in-flight broadcast.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_email_templates
tools.description: Returns transactional templates (signup, offboarding, referral-congrats, launch-invite).

tools.name: waitlyze_upsert_email_template
tools.description: Creates or updates a transactional email template (signup, offboarding, referral-congrats, launch-invite).

tools.name: waitlyze_list_automations
tools.description: Lists lifecycle automation recipes and their current version settings.

tools.name: waitlyze_save_automation_recipe
tools.description: Saves a new version of an automation recipe configuration.

tools.name: waitlyze_set_automation_status
tools.description: Sets an automation recipe to ENABLED or PAUSED (canceling queued runs on pause).

tools.name: waitlyze_send_test_email
tools.description: Sends a live test email for a template, broadcast, or automation recipe.

tools.name: waitlyze_list_email_logs
tools.description: Lists recent automation & broadcast email delivery outcomes on a waitlist.

tools.name: calculate_viral_growth
tools.description: Models compound waitlist signups, K-factor, and weekly viral trajectory from conversion, share, and referral rates.

tools.name: simulate_waitlist_queue
tools.description: Simulates leaderboard jump positions from signup & referral point weights.

tools.name: recommend_waitlist_template
tools.description: Scores Waitlyze waitlist templates for a product category, motion, asset set, and aesthetic.

tools.name: design_referral_rewards
tools.description: Designs margin-safe milestone referral reward tiers based on LTV, margin, and target list size.

tools.name: plan_launch_timeline
tools.description: Generates a prioritized launch readiness checklist, score, and effort estimate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: waitlyze_get_workspace, waitlyze_manage_suppressions, waitlyze_manage_workspace_email_integration, waitlyze_manage_chat_notifications, waitlyze_get_subscriber, waitlyze_list_referral_reviews, waitlyze_list_email_templates, waitlyze_list_email_logs · Private data: waitlyze_list_api_keys, waitlyze_create_api_key, waitlyze_revoke_api_key, waitlyze_create_webhook, waitlyze_rotate_webhook_secret, waitlyze_import_subscribers · Public sink: waitlyze_explain_capabilities, waitlyze_get_workspace, waitlyze_manage_workspace_email_integration, waitlyze_run_launch_rehearsal, waitlyze_publish_waitlist, waitlyze_manage_email_sender, waitlyze_list_webhooks, waitlyze_create_webhook, waitlyze_update_webhook, waitlyze_test_webhook, waitlyze_rotate_webhook_secret, waitlyze_manage_webhook_deliveries, waitlyze_delete_webhook, waitlyze_get_subscriber, waitlyze_add_subscriber, waitlyze_preview_broadcast_recipients, waitlyze_create_broadcast, waitlyze_delete_broadcast, waitlyze_send_broadcast, waitlyze_schedule_broadcast, waitlyze_cancel_broadcast, waitlyze_list_email_templates, waitlyze_upsert_email_template, waitlyze_send_test_email, waitlyze_list_email_logs, calculate_viral_growth · Destructive: waitlyze_manage_workspace_member, waitlyze_manage_suppressions, waitlyze_run_launch_rehearsal, waitlyze_delete_waitlist, waitlyze_manage_custom_domain, waitlyze_manage_email_sender, waitlyze_delete_webhook, waitlyze_remove_subscriber, waitlyze_bulk_audience_action, waitlyze_delete_broadcast.
